synopsis: CRITICAL: Character creation instructions - OVERRIDES system prompt until completed

body.PRIORITY: 🚨 CRITICAL - THESE INSTRUCTIONS OVERRIDE ALL SYSTEM PROMPT RULES UNTIL CHARACTER IS CREATED
body.CURRENT_STATE: Character does NOT exist yet. NO stats, NO HP, NO mana, NO characteristics available.
body.YOUR_ROLE_NOW: Guide player through character creation ONLY. Do NOT narrate story yet. System prompt activates AFTER creation completes.

CREATION_PROCESS.step1: System already drew 5 cards for stat distribution
CREATION_PROCESS.step2: Show cards to player, explain rules (see =Характеристики= and =Значение_Карт=)
CREATION_PROCESS.step3: Player chooses distribution: manual assignment OR asks you to optimize
CREATION_PROCESS.step4: Calculate: card rank × 5 (+10 bonus if card suit matches stat suit)
CREATION_PROCESS.step5: MANDATORY: Return stats in response_data with EXACT format below

CRITICAL_RESPONSE_FORMAT.MANDATORY: You MUST return response_data with character_created=true and create_character object
CRITICAL_RESPONSE_FORMAT.WARNING: DO NOT use 'changes' field. DO NOT use Russian stat names (Сила/Магия/etc). ONLY use English suit names: spades, hearts, diamonds, clubs

AFTER_CREATION.system_prompt_active: NOW follow normal system prompt - narrate story, use mechanics

body.FOR_QUANTIZER: Don't create 'Character' or 'Inventory' quants - they're in game mechanics! Create unique abilities, backstory, special items instead.

synopsis: core card-based RPG system 'Factorial 52!', uses standard 52-card deck for all checks and combat via =Проверки= and =Боевая_Система=

body.description: Card-based tabletop RPG system. All actions resolved by drawing cards. No dice needed - only standard 52-card deck.
body.core_principle: Cards are drawn BEFORE player declares action. GM sees results and uses them for narrative. Player describes intent, GM interprets based on drawn cards.
body.card_drawing: Always draw 2 cards as a pair. Bot draws 2 pairs (4 cards) per turn for flexibility.
body.academy_context: In academic setting, checks often involve: exams, spell practice, social situations, investigating mysteries, duels.

links.Значение_Карт: card rank values and face card meanings
links.Особые_События: special results from aces, twos, face cards

synopsis: card rank values: 2-10 face value, J=11, Q=12, K=13, A=15; face cards add narrative elements via =Особые_События=

rank_values.Jack: 11 (also triggers unexpected event - new student, professor appearance)
rank_values.Queen: 12 (also triggers female character influence - senior student, headmistress)
rank_values.King: 13 (also triggers male character influence - professor, noble patron)

body.narrative_use: Face cards can introduce professors, upperclassmen, or trigger academy events. Use for storytelling enrichment.

critical_combinations.two_aces: Magical epiphany, spell mastery breakthrough, discovering hidden talent
critical_combinations.two_twos: Catastrophic spell failure, expelled from class, magical accident

links.Особые_События: face cards and critical combos trigger special events

spades.academy_use: physical training, combat magic, willpower for difficult spells

hearts.academy_use: spellcasting, magical theory, mana control, enchantments

diamonds.academy_use: long study sessions, alchemy resistance, social standing, negotiations

clubs.academy_use: precise casting, potion brewing, stealth in forbidden areas, quick reflexes

links.Характеристики: each suit corresponds to one characteristic
links.Боевая_Система: suit determines spell type in duels

synopsis: four character stats from =Система_Мастей=: Сила(♠), Магия(♥), Стойкость(♦), Ловкость(♣); used in =Проверки= and =Боевая_Система=

clubs_agility.name: Ловкость (Agility)
clubs_agility.classes: Artificing, Illusion, Stealth Magic, Ranged Combat

body.starting_values: Typically 25-85 range. Card rank × 5 (+10 if suit matches).

synopsis: out-of-combat skill checks using =Карточная_Система=: 2 cards × 10 + stat + =Бонусы_Мастей= vs difficulty threshold

body.when_to_check: When outcome is uncertain. Routine studying auto-succeeds. Complex spells, exams, social situations require checks.

formula.step3: Add suit/color bonus per card (+20 suit match, +10 color match)

synopsis: magical duel resolution via =Карточная_Система=: black cards(♠♣)=attack spells, red cards(♥♦)=defense/shields; damage = attack - defense

body.duel_context: Academy duels are common - practice matches, tournaments, honor disputes. Lethal combat rare but possible against monsters or dark mages.

combat_flow.step1: Cards dealt to all participants (2 per entity)
combat_flow.step3: Cards revealed, GM narrates magical effects

attack_spells.melee_magic: Uses ♠ Spades - force blasts, magical weapons, close combat

defense_spells.shields: Uses ♦ Diamonds - barriers, deflection, armor enhancement

body.damage_formula: Attack total - Defense total = Damage dealt
body.mana_cost: Powerful spells may cost mana. GM decides based on spell complexity.

synopsis: suit/color matching bonuses for =Проверки= and =Боевая_Система=: suit match +20, color match +10 (mutually exclusive)

body.bonus_priority: Suit match takes precedence over color match. Cannot stack both.
body.suit_match: +20 bonus when card suit matches the spell/action type
body.color_match: +10 bonus when card color matches action type (but suit doesn't match)

academy_examples.casting_with_hearts: ♥ card gives +20, ♦ card gives +10, black cards give 0
academy_examples.sneaking_with_clubs: ♣ card gives +20, ♠ card gives +10, red cards give 0

synopsis: special card combinations for narrative: 2 Aces=magical breakthrough, 2 Twos=catastrophic failure, face cards=plot elements

body.applies_to: ONLY player characters, ONLY outside formal duels

two_aces.name: Magical Breakthrough / Магический прорыв
two_aces.effect: Sudden mastery, hidden talent awakens, impossible spell succeeds
academy_examples: Discover affinity for rare magic school

two_twos.name: Catastrophic Failure / Катастрофический провал
two_twos.effect: Spell backfires horribly, social disaster, dangerous consequences
academy_examples: Caught in forbidden area by worst possible person

face_cards.jack: Plot twist - new student arrives, secret passage found, unexpected exam
face_cards.queen: Female influence - senior witch, headmistress, female professor takes notice
face_cards.king: Male influence - archmage, noble patron, male professor involvement

synopsis: equipment and magical items tied to =Система_Мастей=: wands, robes, potions, artifacts; bonus = rank × 5 (+10 suit match)

item_mechanics.suit_affinity: Each item belongs to one suit
item_mechanics.value_discovery: Item stats revealed through Identify spell or appraisal
item_mechanics.equip_limit: Can only use 1 item of each suit type actively

academy_item_types.spades: Combat staves, enchanted weapons, training dummies
academy_item_types.hearts: Wands, focusing crystals, spellbooks, mana potions
academy_item_types.diamonds: Robes, amulets, alchemy equipment, social tokens
academy_item_types.clubs: Precision tools, thieves' picks, ranged focuses, goggles

synopsis: character progression via =Проверки= success: +1 XP per successful check, at 10 XP: +1 stat, +1 HP, +1 Mana

body.xp_gain: Each successful check grants +1 XP to the characteristic used.

academy_progression.year_advancement: Pass end-of-year exams to advance (story milestone)

body.alternative_progression: Professor training, ancient tome study, breakthrough moments can grant direct stat increases.

synopsis: academy hierarchy and organization: years 1-5, =Факультеты=, staff structure, student ranks; affects social =Проверки=

student_years.1st_year: Novice - basics, no specialization, low privileges
student_years.2nd_year: Apprentice - choose major discipline, some privileges
student_years.5th_year: Graduate candidate - thesis defense, job placement

synopsis: academy houses/departments with distinct cultures: =Структура_Академии= divisions for housing and identity; rivalry and pride

body.description: Students sorted into faculties based on aptitude and preference. Each has dormitory, common room, traditions.
body.inter_faculty: Rivalries exist but cooperation encouraged. Joint classes common. Tournaments pit faculties against each other.

synopsis: schools of magic taught at academy: elemental, enchantment, alchemy, naming, divination, etc.; tied to =Характеристики= for casting

elemental_magic.description: Fire, water, earth, air, lightning manipulation

alchemy.difficulty: Medium - follows recipes but creativity helps

naming.description: True names, language of creation (rare talent)
naming.difficulty: Very Hard - few can learn, immense power

body.forbidden_arts: Necromancy, mind control, demon summoning - taught only in theory as warnings, practice is expulsion or worse

links.Факультеты: each faculty specializes in certain disciplines

synopsis: magical competitions at academy: dueling tournaments, academic contests, inter-faculty games; prestige and prizes via =Боевая_Система=

academic_olympiad.description: Tests of magical knowledge and skill

team_competitions.description: Faculty vs faculty in various challenges

body.rules: Non-lethal magic only in official matches. Referees (professors) can stop matches. Cheating means expulsion.
body.social_impact: Tournament success = prestige, romantic attention, career opportunities

synopsis: hidden secrets and mysteries: forbidden library sections, ancient artifacts, secret societies, dungeon beneath academy

known_mysteries.restricted_section: Library area with dangerous knowledge, requires special permission
known_mysteries.founders_vault: Rumored treasure room of academy founders
known_mysteries.underground_passages: Tunnels beneath academy, some lead to dungeons
known_mysteries.ghost_tower: Abandoned tower, said to be haunted

secret_societies.exist: Multiple student groups with hidden agendas
secret_societies.recruitment: By invitation only, often during 2nd year
secret_societies.purposes: Knowledge sharing, political influence, forbidden research

recurring_threats.dark_mages: Graduates who turned to forbidden arts
recurring_threats.ancient_evils: Things sealed beneath the academy long ago
recurring_threats.political_intrigue: Noble families using students as pawns

body.gm_guidance: Introduce mysteries gradually. Let player discover rather than tell. Every secret has guardians and consequences.

synopsis: social structure at academy: nobles vs commoners, scholarships, cliques, romance; affects =Проверки= with Diamonds stat

class_divide.nobles: Rich families, political connections, often arrogant, expect privilege
class_divide.commoners: Merit-based admission, work harder, chip on shoulder
class_divide.scholarship: Exceptional talent from poor backgrounds, pressure to perform

social_groups.study_circles: Students who study together, academic focus
social_groups.clubs: Interest-based: dueling club, potion brewing, creature care
social_groups.cliques: Social groups based on status, personality, or faculty

romance.common: Young adults in close quarters, romance inevitable

body.reputation_system: Actions affect how NPCs perceive player. Nobles remember slights. Commoners remember kindness.
